headline: Will Tuesday be a a blue wave or just an anti-Trump surge?
author: Douglas MacKinnon, opinion contributor

paragraphs.text: Poll after poll shows the Democrats comfortably retaking the House come Nov.  Maybe.         To be sure, the Republican brand is in a world of hurt right now, with tens of millions of voters not willing to let the party wiggle off the hook of accountability, since Republicans control the White House, the Senate and the House.
”   Watch what you wish for.   To be sure, millions of Americans in and out of the MAGA base still strongly believe in the president, his brand and his policies. Many believe he saved our nation.

But viewing the flip side of that coin, some could certainly make the case that a large percentage of the votes Joe Biden got in 2020 and Kamala Harris got in 2024 were not votes for those two Democratic presidential nominees so much as votes against Trump.   Many Republicans I speak with believe that their party is bleeding votes, from independents, youths. minorities, even faith-based votes.

They honestly wonder how they could be losing to nothing but sheer hatred of Donald Trump.   Is that enough for the Democrats to have a great day on Nov. 3, even with no real solutions to the issues plaguing this nation?
We’ll just have to wait and see.
